title: laiaskills manifest
description: Which skills laiaskills installs, and the source each one comes from. Source details (URL, branch, shallow) live in .gitmodules.

claudePlugins.description: Claude Code plugins expected to be installed, as `<plugin>@<marketplace>`. `laiaskills doctor` reports missing and undeclared ones; installing stays with `/plugin`. Leave out to not track plugins.

source.description: `first-party` for skills under first-party/<plugin>/skills/, otherwise a submodule path such as third-party/<owner>__<repo> or first-party/<plugin>/upstream.

path.description: Folder of the skill inside the source. Only needed when the name matches more than one skill.

skipMirrors.description: Mirrors (keys of `mirrors` in tools/config/agents.json) that get no link to this skill, e.g. ["claude"] for a skill Claude already gets another way. The hub copy is still installed.
